title: Lead free crystal whiskey glasses
text: Lead free crystal whiskey glasses. Purchased these for a the family christmas bingo prize pile... lots of whiskey sippers - these are pretty glasses - squarish with roundish edges.  Come in a nice gift box.  I think they will go quickly! Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
